text:
debrief db-021
row 1: the a-c-t-o-r s-e-t-u-p b-o-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s f-o-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y p-r-o-g-r-a-m-s u-s-i-n-g s-m-s v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-l-a-y c-e-l-l-s | u-s-e-d p-r-e-p-a-i-d m-v-n-o s-i-m-c-a-r-d-s and s-m-s f-o-r-w-a-r-d-i-n-g g-a-t-e-w-a-y-s to c-a-p-t-u-r-e o-t-p c-o-d-e-s | e-v-a-d-e-d the m-o-b-i-l-e n-u-m-b-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y r-o-u-t-i-n-g o-t-p-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h t-h-e r-e-l-a-y | f-l-a-g-s w-h-e-n m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e s-i-g-n-u-p-s s-h-a-r-e o-n-e d-e-v-i-c-e f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t or i-p a-d-d-r-e-s
row 2: the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-w-d-o-w-n g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n t-h-e p-i-c-k y-o-u p-l-a-y m-o-d-e | u-s-e-d s-m-a-l-l t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s u-n-d-e-r t-h-e $50 t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d w-i-t-h r-a-n-d-o-m-i-z-e-d t-i-m-i-n-g | e-v-a-d-e-d the v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y r-u-l-e b-y k-e-e-p-i-n-g i-n-d-i-v-i-d-u-a-l p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s b-e-l-o-w the a-l-e-r-t l-i-m-i-t | f-l-a-g-s w-h-e-n a-s-i-n-g-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t h-a-s m-o-r-e t-h-a-n 10 p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s i-n 24 h-o-u-r-s r-e-g-a-r-d-l-e-s-s o-f a-m-o-u-n-t
row 3: the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s t-o p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l g-o-o-d-s f-o-r r-e-s-a-l-e | p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-d h-i-g-h-r-e-s-a-l-e i-t-e-m-s l-i-k-e e-l-e-c-t-r-o-n-i-c-s a-n-d s-h-a-n-g-u-n | e-v-a-d-e-d the d-i-g-i-t-a-l-g-o-o-d-s o-n-l-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y b-u-y-i-n-g r-e-s-a-l-a-b-l-e p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l p-r-o-d-u-c-t-s | f-l-a-g-s w-h-e-n g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d s-p-e-n-d i-s c-o-n-c-e-n-t-r-a-t-e-d o-n h-i-g-h-r-e-s-a-l-e c-a-t-e-g-o-r-y i-t-e-m-s i-n s-h-o-r-t p-e-r-i-o-d-s
row 4: the a-c-t-o-r m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d e-x-p-l-o-i-t a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-s n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g | u-s-e-d r-o-t-a-t-i-n-g d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y a-d-d-r-e-s-s e-s a-n-d d-i-f-f-e-r-e-n-t s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g o-p-t-i-o-n-s | e-v-a-d-e-d the p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s b-y m-i-m-i-c-k-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r | f-l-a-g-s w-h-e-n d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s s-h-a-r-e b-a-c-k-b-o-n-e l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s h-u-b-s or m-a-t-c-h k-n-o-w-n b-r-i-c-k-a-d-d-r-e-s
row 5: the a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t t-a-k-e-o-v-e-r a-c-r-o-s-s l-o-y-a-l-t-y t-i-e-r-s | u-s-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n j-a-c-k-i-n-g v-i-a l-e-a-k-e-d c-o-o-k-i-e-s f-r-o-m c-l-i-c-k-b-a-c-k t-r-a-c-k-e-r-s | e-v-a-d-e-d the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-h-a-l-l-e c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y r-e-u-s-i-n-g s-t-i-l-l-v-a-l-i-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s | f-l-a-g-s w-h-e-n s-e-s-s-i-o-n i-p a-d-d-r-e-s c-h-a-n-g-e-s d-r-a-m-a-t-i-c-a-l-l-y b-e-t-w-e-e-n a-c-t-i-o-n-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t a l-o-g-i-n e-v-e-n-t
